name: fedsub-bench
description: Complete study artifact for a cross-gateway benchmark of federated GraphQL subscriptions (Apollo Router 2.17.0, Cosmo Router 0.341.0, Hive Router 0.2.0): the Go load-generation harness with exact per-subscriber correctness accounting, gateway configurations (verbatim), subgraph implementations, the pre-specified experiment protocol (E0-E13), suite definitions, EC2 orchestration, raw results for all 448 instrumented runs (including runs excluded from statistics), the analysis pipeline, and reproduction instructions (REPRODUCE.md; a reduced-cost laptop reproduction and a full EC2 reproduction are both documented). Docker image digests, AMI, and versions are pinned in VERSIONS.md. Licensed MIT.
